notes.title: FREE BETA-TEST
notes.content:
This game is a BETA-TEST with a TEMPORARY web-based UI.

Play for free now at: http://starforce.hotepgames.com

As a beta-tester, please provide constructive feedback about the gameplay (playability, victory conditions, missions, etc..., not the UI) on my forum: http://forum.hotepgames.com

Once 20 or more players have provided constructive feedback on my forum, I will create the final, 3d-Graphical UI for the game (not web-based).

Everyone who provided constructive feedback will receive a free copy of the final game.
